attributes.action: Stop shop club cards from affecting prices.
attributes.additional_details: Im not against points schemes ect it's clearly just the two tier prices system. Everyone should pay one fair price and people such as the elderly are being destroyed by these things.
attributes.background: We need to stop being charged higher prices because you don't have a store card. Items can clearly be sold for profit at the lower price so why should they need every bit of data collection on a customer to do so. This is a clear sign of two tier selling in an cost of living crisis

rejection.details: This is a matter for supermarkets.
